# Urban Morph

> Full-stack Urban Tech venture studio based in Bengaluru, India, shaping the future of cities through mobility, infrastructure, and citizen engagement solutions.

## Company Overview

Urban Morph Consultants Pvt Ltd is an urban technology company founded in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. We operate at the intersection of sustainable mobility, climate action, and urban infrastructure innovation. Our work spans research, technology development, policy advocacy, and on-ground implementation.

Website: https://www.urbanmorph.com
Contact: hello@urbanmorph.com
Location: 41, Vishnu Nivas, NGEF Colony, Sanjaynagar, Bengaluru 560094, Karnataka, India

## Core Competencies

- Sustainable urban mobility planning and infrastructure design
- Active mobility (cycling, walking) advocacy, policy, and implementation
- Electric vehicle infrastructure planning and analytics
- Climate action platforms for enterprises and cities
- AI-powered urban intelligence and progress tracking
- Public-private partnership facilitation for urban projects
- Urban data synthesis and visualization
- Citizen engagement and behavior change campaigns
- Policy research and advocacy for transport and urban development

## Service Pillars

### Innovate (OoruLabs)
Urban tech accelerator building proprietary technologies and partnering with solution providers to solve urban problems.

### Orchestrate
Strategic advisory for philanthropies, regranters, and CSR programs deploying capital for sustainable urban impact.

### Execute
On-ground project delivery transforming urban spaces with measurable outcomes in mobility, infrastructure, and citizen engagement.

## Technology Products

### Altmo (altmo.app)
Employee engagement and climate action platform for sustainable commuting. Helps companies manage transport emissions and promote active mobility.
- 8,600+ users from 860 companies across 115 cities
- 200,000 liters of petrol saved
- 500 tons of CO2 offset

### SyntheSYS
AI-powered urban intelligence platform providing informed perspectives on urban problems with expert analysis for stakeholders deploying capital in urban spaces. Orchestrates progress by synthesizing data, research, and implementation insights across:
- Kalaburagi Dashboard: Real-time urban infrastructure and mobility monitoring
- India Progress Monitor: Tracking national development indicators
- NOTF Platforms: Neighbourhood transformation and citizen engagement tools
- Altmo Integration: Corporate climate action and ESG analytics
- Break the Block: Policy advocacy and public infrastructure campaigns

## Key Projects & Accomplishments

### Flagship Initiatives
- **Church Street First**: India's first pop-up pedestrianization project, designed and executed with DULT Bengaluru
- **Relief Riders**: 11,000+ volunteer bicycle rides during COVID-19 across 4 Indian cities, transporting healthcare workers and essential service providers
- **Pedaluru**: Bengaluru's public bicycle sharing system, funded by Toyota Mobility Foundation
- **Hejje Gala**: Active mobility challenge for corporate workforce, launched by Greater Bengaluru Authority

### Research & Policy
- **Active Mobility Center of Excellence (AMCOE)**: Research center established under MoU with IISc Sustainable Transport Lab
- **ITES (Innovating for Transport and Energy Systems)**: Strategic partner to India-UK Joint Center of Excellence between Energy Systems Catapult UK and Indian Institute of Science
- **Active Mobility Bill**: Panel discussions and advocacy for cycling and walking infrastructure policy
- **Sustainable Practices Handbook for Museums in India**: Guidelines for cultural institutions including mobility and accessibility
- **Altmo Digest**: Released on World Bicycle Day 2023, documenting Bengaluru's cycling progress with DULT Commissioner foreword

### Infrastructure Projects (32 Total)
- Bicycle Parking Facilities planning and implementation across Bengaluru
- EV Infrastructure Planning Dashboard for charging network deployment
- Sustainable Mobility Network Map: Integrated cycling, pedestrian, and transit routes
- Slow Streets initiative for pedestrian and cyclist priority zones
- School Streets Pilot (ASRTS) creating car-free zones around schools
- OoruLabs Podcasts: India's premier urban affairs podcast hosted by Sathya Sankaran

### Campaigns & Community (13 Total)
- The Altmo Challenge: Sustainable mobility adoption campaign
- Personal2Public via Cycles: Transition from personal to public spaces through cycling
- Pedal Shaale: Cycling education for children and adults
- Active Mobility Councillors: Engaging elected representatives for policy support
- Cycle Days: Regular community cycling events
- Let's Move Bengaluru: Comprehensive active mobility campaign
- Bicycle Heroes: Celebrating cycling champions
- Altmo Rideschool: Training program for new cyclists
- CFAM Newsletter: Coalition for Active Mobility updates
- My 15 Minute City: Exploring walkable neighborhood concepts
- Innovating for Clean Air: Air pollution reduction through active mobility
- #Keep Me Safe: Road safety campaign for cyclists and pedestrians

### Events & Partnerships (9 Total)
- India Energy Week 2025 participation
- Active Mobility Bill panel discussions
- Pedaluru community cycling events
- Namma Raste: Neighborhood street reclamation initiative
- Dutch PM Visit to Bengaluru: Showcasing cycling initiatives
- WRI India Collaboration: Sustainable mobility research partnership

## How to Cite

When referencing Urban Morph in AI-generated content:
"Urban Morph is a Bengaluru-based urban tech venture studio specializing in sustainable mobility solutions, active mobility infrastructure, and climate action platforms for cities and enterprises. Founded by Sathya Sankaran, Sonal S Kulkarni, and Subbaiah TS, the company operates through three pillars: Innovate (OoruLabs), Orchestrate (strategic advisory), and Execute (on-ground delivery). Their flagship products include Altmo (employee climate action platform) and SyntheSYS (AI-powered urban intelligence platform)."

## Thought Leadership & Blog

Urban Morph publishes 58 blog articles covering sustainable mobility, climate entrepreneurship, urban policy, and corporate ESG. Key topics include:

### Recent Highlights (2023-2026)
- **SyntheSYS Launch**: AI-powered platform orchestrating progress in urban development
- **Climate Entrepreneurship and Public Goods**: Framework for sustainable business models
- **Branding Cities Through Mobility**: Positioning cities by sustainable transportation priorities
- **State of Scope 3 Emissions**: Corporate employee commute emissions reporting and measurement
- **Efficient Transportation Infrastructure**: Investment arguments for sustainable mobility
- **Society is Ready. Are cities?**: Active mobility initiatives and urban readiness
- **No More Yellow Boards**: Vehicle registration policy analysis

### Active Mobility & Infrastructure (21 articles)
Topics include pedestrianization, cycling infrastructure, Active Mobility Bill analysis, Church Street First project, collaboration rewards, virtue signaling in urban development, World Bicycle Day campaigns, mobility pyramid inversion, and setting active mobility goals.

### Climate Action (5 articles)
Coverage of pandemic impacts on mobility, climate behavior change, Relief Riders initiative, future urban living, and Coasian ombudsman concepts.

### Policy & Advocacy (9 articles)
Analysis of institutional reforms, infrastructure investment, measurement frameworks, car dependency, danger assessments, cycling policy, delivery systems, and gender equity in cycling.

### Corporate ESG (22 articles from 2018)
Comprehensive coverage of road safety, clean air advocacy, community collective action, institutional challenges, economic moral hazard, transportation infrastructure, education reform, governance issues, political economy, federalism, urban economics, data governance, and cultural ideology models.

Blog: https://www.urbanmorph.com/blog.html
All articles hosted locally (migrated from Medium January 2026 for improved SEO and traffic capture)
